test_objectives: Validate the Form Authentication Login flow at the-internet.herokuapp.com/login end-to-end — covering page load state, valid and invalid credential submission, flash message display and dismissal, logout, and session-based access control for the /secure area — through automated Playwright regression tests that catch regressions without manual re-testing.
key_findings: All 30 test cases passed across 10 use-case groups (Initial Page State, Valid Login Flow, Invalid Username, Invalid Password, Empty Fields Validation, Flash Message Behavior, Logout Flow, Unauthorized Access, Security and Input Validation, Browser Navigation Behavior) with a 100% success rate in 0.3 minutes on Chromium. No defects were detected — the application correctly handles valid credentials, rejects invalid/empty inputs with appropriate error flash messages, enforces session-based access control on /secure, dismisses flash messages on close, and safely handles SQL injection, XSS, special characters, Unicode, and long input without error.
recommendations: No corrective action is needed — the suite is fully passing with zero defects. Consider expanding coverage to additional browsers (Firefox, WebKit) if cross-browser regression confidence is desired, and scheduling periodic re-runs to detect regressions introduced by upstream changes to the target application.
conclusion: The Form Authentication Login feature is functioning correctly across all tested scenarios. The suite provides solid regression coverage for the authentication flow and is ready for ongoing use as a gate against future regressions.
